notes.title: Update 1.0.3 [EA]: Patch Notes
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.3 [EA] for Astronomics Rise of a New Empire is now available!

Full patch notes:

[b]New features[/b]
- Roadmap button in the main menu

[b]Quality of life improvements:[/b]
- You can buy a new starting ship if yours has been destroyed
- A notification will appear if no target planet has been selected

[b]Balance changes:[/b]
- Recipe: Frigate 20 -> 50
- Recipe: Light Frigate 15 -> 25
- Recipe: Heavy Frigate 25 -> 100
- Recipe: Small Storage 2 -> 10
- Recipe: Medium Storage 4 -> 25
- Recipe: Large Storage 5 -> 50
- Recipe: Old Thruster 2 -> 5
- Recipe: Modern Thruster 4 -> 15
- Recipe: Hyper Thruster 5 -> 25
- Modules: Frigate 100 -> 200 (EC)
- Modules: Heavy Frigate 200 -> 400 (EC)
- The production time of the components has been adjusted to the price


Have fun

notes.title: Update 1.0.2 [EA]: Patch Notes
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.2 [EA] for Astronomics Rise of a New Empire is now available!

[u][b]Warning: Some technologies may need to be researched again for old saves[/b][/u].

Full patch notes:

[b]New features[/b]
- Seasons now have a type
- Seasons influence the population
- Seasons and season types have buffs and de-buffs
- New technology: Modern farming
- New Technology: Population Heat Adaptation
- New Technology: Population Cold Adaptation
- New technology: Heat-resistant seeds
- New Technology: Cold Resistant Seeds
- New Technology: Employee Contracts
- New technology: Unified contracts
- New technology: Modern tools
- New technology: Mining lasers
- New technology: AI tools
- New technology: Assembly line work
- New technology: Automated factories
- New technology requirements

[b]Bug fix:[/b]
- Asteroid transportation line is removed from the map if no target planet is selected.
- Tesla tower sound effect now ends together with the animation
- New agents are no longer created when loading a savegame
- The exit button in the settings menu now takes you back to the menu
- Info for the available sales offers when there are none is now correctly hidden
- It is no longer possible to select targets for spaceships in unexplored areas
- Preview of asteroid data is now displayed correctly even at level 0
- Time acceleration is reset when switching to the main menu
- Tutorials and exploration messages are no longer displayed again when the game reloads

[b]Quality of life improvements:[/b]
- There are now buttons in the planet interface to switch directly between your planets
- There are now buttons in the asteroid interface to switch directly between your own asteroids
- It is now possible to pause the training of agents
- It is now possible to pause the production of spaceships
- It is now possible to add multiple agents to the training queue
- The player will be notified when an agent has been recruited
- Empty stars show the talent and filled stars show the current level of the agents
- Visual revision of the research tree
- Division of the research tree into 4 areas
- Camera movements in the spaceship editor have been improved
- Food and food production is now displayed in 1K for 1000 format

[b]AI improvement:[/b]
- Enemy ships break off pursuit when you leave their area
- New ship design for the AI

[b]Balance changes:[/b]
- Training duration of agents 1 -> 10
- Production time of starships 1 -> 10
- Roxus Prime Max Population 100 -> 125
- Turos Max Population 100 -> 80
- Oblios Max population 100 -> 60
- Florix Max population 100 -> 50
- Muskar Max population 100 -> 40
- Saros Max Population 100 -> 110
- Voluntar Max Population 100 -> 140
- Evex V Max Population 100 -> 200
- Taladar Max Population 100 -> 120
- Nodium Max Population 100 -> 180
- Serezyl Max Population 100 -> 120
- Eskatur Max Population 100 -> 80
- Akatan Max Population 100 -> 60
- Kalandur Max Population 100 -> 120
- Zorus Dakar Max Population 100 -> 160

Have fun

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 [EA]: Patch Notes
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.1 [EA] for Astronomics Rise of a New Empire is now available!

Full patch notes:

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
- The overview map is no longer visible in the standard view
- Your own trust and sympathy values are no longer displayed
- The cost title in the create trade route interface is now displayed correctly
- The information board for the costs in the create trade route interface no longer broken
- The target planet of the asteroid no longer appears in the selection

[b]Quality of life improvements:[/b]
- An asteroid can now have no target planet
- It is now possible to deselect a target planet in the asteroid interface
- When you capture an asteroid, it does not have a target planet
- An info text is displayed if there are no target planets to choose from
- An info text is displayed if no trade is available for the selected planet combination
- Error messages are displayed if you select an unavailable planet on the trade map.

[b]Balance changes:[/b]
- Trade ship maintenance 20 -> 2
- The maximum trade route distance of 175 is now also applied to asteroids
- The AI buy and sell price of food has been reduced.

[b]Performance optimization:[/b]
- Improvement of the overall performance
- Improved performance on the first page of the planet interface
- Improved performance in the standard view
- Reduction of frame drops

Have fun

notes.title: Steam store page release - announcement
notes.content:
[h3]Hey guys,[/h3]

I am happy to announce that today we have [b]published the store page of Astronomics Rise of a new Empire[/b].

For us this is a huge step and an incredible feeling.

It feels really good to see your [b]own game on Steam[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43734756/74497e1c516b6ab8c3941e1729c7069c0db2c3d0.png[/img]

We would be very happy if you [b]add the game to your wishlist[/b], so you will be notified when we release the game.

This would [b]support us a lot[/b] and [b]it's completely free[/b].

Astronomics Rise of a new Empire will be [b]released towards the end of this year[/b], more details will be available at a later date.

In the meantime, have fun!
